text:
`sqlpipe` copies tables from a PostgreSQL database to an Amazon S3 bucket. It writes the data as Parquet files. Use `sqlpipe` when you need to move data from Postgres to a data lake or an analytics system.

The tool connects to your database, reads the rows from each table you specify, and writes the output to S3. You can run `sqlpipe` on a schedule to keep the Parquet files up to date. The tool supports full table exports and incremental exports based on a timestamp column. It does not modify your database. It only reads from it.
